blocks.prompt: 6 From a standard deck of 52 playing cards, there are 26 black cards and 26 red cards. How many different possible ways are made of eight cards if select 3 cards of black colour and others are of red colour?
blocks.explanation:
8 cards ka ek haath (hand) banana hai: 3 black aur baqi \(8 - 3 = 5\) red.
Find kya karna hai? Aise kitne mukhtalif haath ban sakte hain. Haath mein cards ki tarteeb se farq nahi parta.
Plan: black ke liye \({}^{26}C_{3}\), red ke liye \({}^{26}C_{5}\), phir multiply.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 26 black aur 26 red cards; kul 8 cards jin mein 3 black.
Humein find karna hai: 8 cards ke kitne mukhtalif selections.
Tareeqa: Sawal ka chhupa hua hissa pehchanein: "others are of red colour" ka matlab baqi \(8 - 3 = 5\) cards red hain. Har rang ka selection alag combination hai, aur dono ek saath hote hain, is liye multiply.

Black cards chunein
\[{}^{26}C_{3} = \dfrac{26 \cdot 25 \cdot 24}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= 26 \cdot 25 \cdot 4 = 2600\]
Kyun: Neeche \(3! = 6\) hai aur upar 24 hai; \(24 \div 6 = 4\). Pehle cancel kiya to sirf \(26 \times 100 = 2600\) bacha.

Red cards chunein
\[{}^{26}C_{5} = \dfrac{26 \cdot 25 \cdot 24 \cdot 23 \cdot 22}{120}\]
\[= 65780\]
Kyun: 26 se neeche paanch numbers, divide by \(5! = 120\). Yeh wahi number hai jo Question 4 mein aaya tha, is liye dobara lamba hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahi.

Multiply karein
\[2600 \times 65780\]
\[= 26 \times 65780 \times 100\]
\[= 1710280 \times 100\]
\[= 171028000\]
Kyun: Har black selection har red selection ke saath ja sakta hai. 2600 ko \(26 \times 100\) likha taake multiplication aasaan ho: pehle \(26 \times 65780 = 1710280\), phir do zero laga diye.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{52}C_{8}\) lagana ghalat hai, woh rang ki shart ke baghair saare 8-card haath ginta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[1710280 \div 26 = 65780 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ulta divide karne par red wala number wapas aa gaya, yani multiplication sahi hai.
